task.title: To release a document lock
task.shortdesc: Before you can release a lock on a document, it must be checked out. Releasing

context.p: Before you can release a lock on a document, it must be checked out. Releasing a lock reverts the check-out of the document you are working on without checking it in. You can only release a lock when you have the document open in X-Author.

step.cmd: From the X-Author pane, click on the Lock Status tab icon. The Lock Status page shows agreement details and information on the current document lock.
Click Release Lock on the Lock Status page.

If you chose to release the lock, the document check-out is reverted. Any changes you made while the document was checked out are not saved. The page refreshes to reflect unlocked status and most menu options are disabled.

result.p: If you release a document lock in error and want to continue working with the document, go to the Lock Status page and click Acquire Lock.
